$comment: Living contract registry for general-authority. Statuses are evidence-backed; pending means not yet demonstrated. Do not mark ratified without a command.

invariants.title: A derived authority never widens its parent
invariants.statement: Every authority record narrows or equals the scope, verbs, resources, and expiry of the authority it derives from. Widening is refused, not clamped silently.

invariants.title: An authority is a handle, never a value
invariants.statement: No authority record, route, or projection exposes a secret value or a getSecret() affordance; agent-facing authority is ConnectionRef + Intent.
invariants.notes: Inherited invariant, restated here so the generalization cannot quietly drop it.

invariants.title: The OpenFGA model delta is additive
invariants.statement: New types and relations may only add reachable tuples. No check that returned true against the baseline model may return false against the delta.

invariants.title: Every authority has exactly one parent scope, rooted at a project
invariants.statement: The hierarchy terminates at a project (ADR 0038); organizations remain an optional tier above and nothing requires one.
invariants.notes: ADR 0038 established projects as the top-level container but defined no general authority edge; that gap is what ADR 0120 addresses, by reference.

invariants.title: Deadlines publish on the lifecycle feed
invariants.statement: An authority's expiry is detected by the lifecycle scanner and published on lifecycle.*; no private due-check anywhere.
invariants.notes: ADR 0074 contract. Unwired for authority records.

invariants.title: A delegation chain terminates
invariants.statement: Depth is bounded, cycles are refused at write time, and evaluation cannot loop.
invariants.enforcementPoint: domain model write path + host-core evaluation
invariants.notes: Bound not yet chosen. Choosing it is GA-A-03, not an implementation detail.

invariants.title: Revoking a parent revokes its descendants
invariants.statement: A revoked ancestor makes every derived authority unusable on the next read, not eventually.
invariants.notes: Interaction with OpenFGA tuple caching is unanalysed.

invariants.title: Grant and AccessLease are one record
invariants.statement: Any product-facing renaming is a presentation choice over a single stored authority record. Two names may never become two models or two ledgers.
invariants.notes: AccessLease does not appear anywhere in the repository at baseline; it is a proposed product view only.

invariants.title: A sensitive authority change is digest-bound
invariants.statement: Human approval of an authority change commits to the request digest, the decision verb, and the effective policy digest, and is spent once.
invariants.notes: Which authority mutations are 'sensitive' is undecided.

invariants.title: The client plane keeps one share ledger
invariants.statement: Local authority in apps/pages remains the local share-grant ledger; no parallel local store is introduced.

invariants.title: Guest access is untouched
invariants.statement: No authority change may gate, hide, or condition the guest/anonymous roads, and the tests asserting guest isolation stay as they are.
invariants.notes: AGENTS.md § 5 names this as a repeatedly-regressed contract.

invariants.title: Every new capability is registered or ADR-excluded
invariants.statement: Each new route, CLI verb, or UI action gets a packages/capability-registry entry mapping it onto the MCP/WebMCP surfaces, or excludes it citing an ADR.
invariants.enforcementPoint: parity tests in mcp-host, mcp-client, pages, both CLIs
